disease: McCune-Albright syndrome (post-zygotic mosaic GNAS activating mutation; polyostotic fibrous dysplasia + cafe-au-lait macules + hyperfunctioning endocrinopathy; MAS)
suspended_reason: The cause is a POST-ZYGOTIC SOMATIC-MOSAIC ACTIVATING mutation of GNAS (the gene for the stimulatory G-protein alpha-subunit, Gs-alpha) -- most commonly p.Arg201His or p.Arg201Cys -- that arises AFTER fertilisation in a subset of cells, so the disease-causing lesion is ABSENT from the inherited / germline reference sequence and is present only as a MOSAIC in affected tissues (the anatomical distribution of mutant cells determines which bones and endocrine organs are involved). The Arg201 substitution disables the intrinsic GTPase of Gs-alpha, locking it GTP-bound -> constitutive adenylate-cyclase / cAMP / PKA signalling -> autonomous endocrine hyperfunction (gonadotropin-independent precocious puberty, hyperthyroidism, growth-hormone excess, FGF23-mediated renal phosphate wasting) plus fibrous dysplasia of bone and cafe-au-lait macules. Why this kit MUST hold it: the GNAS PROMOTER is in fact perfectly readable as reference DNA (cached gamma 1.4256, chr20), but (a) the lesion is a CODING activating point mutation, not a promoter-switch change, AND (b) -- the decisive point -- it is a SOMATIC MOSAIC mutation that is NOT PRESENT in the inherited sequence the engine reads at all. A constitutional (germline) Arg201 activating mutation is thought to be embryonic-lethal, surviving only as mosaicism; by definition such a lesion cannot be recovered from the reference promoter. This opens an EIGHTH held MECHANISM CLASS -- post-zygotic SOMATIC MOSAICISM -- genuinely distinct from the seven already held: (1) whole-chromosome ANEUPLOIDY (Down); (2) IMPRINTING (Prader-Willi / Angelman / Beckwith-Wiedemann); (3) repeat-CONTRACTION-driven chromatin DEREPRESSION (FSHD / DUX4); (4)-(5) the MITOCHONDRIAL GENOME (LHON / MELAS point mutations; Kearns-Sayre structural deletion); (6) the contiguous-gene MICRODELETION (22q11.2); (7) repeat-EXPANSION-driven promoter CpG-METHYLATION silencing (Fragile X). It is also a pointed contrast ON THE SAME GNAS LOCUS to the GERMLINE GNAS disorders -- pseudohypoparathyroidism type 1a / Albright hereditary osteodystrophy (INACTIVATING, parent-of-origin-IMPRINTED, germline-readable) -- proving the hold keys on the SOMATIC-MOSAIC nature of the lesion, not on the gene (the germline GNAS disorders would be a separate, imprinting-class question; the activating somatic disease is the mosaicism-class hold). Suspended PURELY on engine-readability (a somatic lesion not in the inherited sequence), NOT for lack of therapy -- management is organ-directed (aromatase inhibitors / tamoxifen for precocious puberty; bisphosphonates / anti-RANKL denosumab for fibrous dysplasia; burosumab where FGF23-driven hypophosphataemia dominates), with a Gs-alpha / cAMP-directed disease-modifying therapy still investigational. Disclosed, not dropped. (Weinstein 1991 NEJM 325:1688 [GNAS R201 mosaic activating mutation]; Schwindinger 1992 PNAS 89:5152; Boyce & Collins 2020 [MAS / fibrous dysplasia review]).
discipline: no analyzable single-gene DNA read -> held (author's rule). Disclosed, not dropped.
